title: Indonesia Electric Mobility Intelligence — passenger cars, motorcycles and electrification ecosystem
scope: Separate battery-electric passenger-car wholesales, two-wheeler sales and in-use population; do not interpret annual sales as cumulative EV fleet stock.

types.name: Battery Electric Vehicle
types.definition: Plug-in full-battery vehicle with no combustion propulsion; reported car wholesales exclude electric motorcycles.

types.name: Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle
types.definition: Can be charged externally but also burns fuel. Do not add to BEV series.

types.name: Hybrid Electric Vehicle
types.definition: Combustion plus electric drivetrain; typically non-plug-in. Not a zero-tailpipe vehicle.

types.name: Battery-electric motorcycle
types.definition: Two-wheel electric vehicle. Annual AISMOLI sales data, SRUT registration and estimated in-use population use different statistical methods.

types.name: Battery-electric bus
types.definition: Public transport EV fleet; avoid conflating stock with factory output.

types.name: Battery-electric truck
types.definition: Commercial EV project and deployment pipeline; a comparable audited national 2026 fleet total is unavailable.

gaikindo_wholesale.classification: BEV passenger-car wholesale as media reports based on GAIKINDO; confirm official category workbook on each update
gaikindo_wholesale.note: Reported sales are wholesales (factory to dealer), not end-user registrations or registered stock.

production.classification: Indonesian domestic battery-electric car production, not vehicle deliveries
production.prior_comparator_note: 2025 comparator quoted in media report; unclear whether full-year or Jan–Sep, DO NOT calculate YoY growth from unlike periods.

quarterly_snapshot.method: Official Kemenperin citing GAIKINDO Q1 BEV sales

cars.monthly_note: Selected months only, not a continuous monthly time series; do not interpolate unreported months.

stock_verified.definition: Passenger electric car population reported by Kemenperin for April 2026, rather than Jan–Sep wholesale sales.
stock_verified.method_note: Published April stock appears to have increased unusually sharply from March; confirm original Kemenperin registry/definitions before declaring precise month-on-month physical adoption.

cars.stock_gap: April 2026 Kemenperin reported 223,100 passenger EV car stock; no audited August 2026 car-only split. Unusual March to April jump requires registry reconciliation.

h1_2026_official.note: H1 BEV passenger car wholesale share, not share of all vehicle fleet stock.

h1_hev.note: HEV is a separate powertrain; not added to BEV

sales_2026.attribution: AISMOLI chair reported through detikFinance 21 Sep 2026
sales_2026.classification: Industry association-reported sales; not official SRUT registered output

srut_sales_2025.attribution: Kemenhub SRUT registrations as reported by detikOto
srut_sales_2025.note: SRUT-based reported figure is not the same statistical series as AISMOLI 2026 numbers.

srut_sales_2024.attribution: Kemenhub SRUT registrations as reported by detikOto

aismoli_sales_2025_estimate.note: Approximate AISMOLI verbal estimate, distinct from Kemenhub SRUT 55,059. Do not merge methods.

fleet_stock.note: Registered/in-use population as reported; not annual units sold.

all_motorcycle_sales_2025.note: All motorcycle powertrains, including ICE. No like-period 2026 denominator for BEV motorcycle share.

fleet_stock_later.note: Later Kemenperin passenger vehicle category population, distinct from Feb 236,451 recorded electric motorcycles.

spklu_units.definition: PLN and partner charging machines / connectors-as-reported (SPKLU units), NOT locations or charging sessions
spklu_units.note: March observation remains 4,769 machine units, accompanied by newer May >=5,000 milestone. The two are separate vintages.

corridors.scope: Mudik Sumatra–Java–Bali routes; subset of national SPKLU

motorcycle_battery_swap_stations.note: National comparable audited SPBKLU sites/bays by 2026 not verified; not equal to car SPKLU.

infrastructure.advisory: Grid availability, effective uptime, charging power mix and connector standard are distinct from installed machine counts. Latest published threshold reached at least 5,000th unit May 2026, but exact latest all-Indonesia SPKLU total and nationwide geographic distribution in October are not independently reconciled.

milestone_5000.note: PLN inaugurated its 5,000th charging unit in Tanjung Priok. This is a dated achievement marker (at least 5,000 reached), NOT verified exact October 2026 count or station-site total.

targets.status: Government stated 2030 population ambition; verify amendments to subsequent policy instruments before treating as enacted mandatory quota.
targets.avoid: Compare only registered EV fleet stock to 2030 population targets; 2026 wholesale car sales cannot be used as progress against cumulative population target.
targets.stock_comparison_note: Use Apr 2026 stock (223,100 passenger EV cars / 242,909 motorcycles) for target comparisons; Aug 2026 nationwide EV stock 541,678 is all classes and cannot be allocated by vehicle type from public data.

industry.name: BYD electric passenger-car manufacturing facility inaugurated
industry.status: Factory inauguration / manufacturing facility as reported by ANTARA at the ceremony; verify actual monthly output, local procurement and audited capital expenditure separately
industry.note: Reported BYD product domestic-content range, not necessarily audited for every model or plant.

industry.name: Indonesian EV batteries — first reported exports
industry.status: Commercial operations / first exports announced at Weda Bay; do not equate group-wide project values with battery factory-specific capex
industry.participants: REPT Battero and upstream industrial players

industry.name: National electric motorcycle (MoLiNas) / ALVA ecosystem
industry.status: National EV motorcycle launch, with a commemorated ALVA production milestone of 20,000 units, not proof of 20,000 MoLiNas sold

industry.name: Domestic EV component supply-chain program
industry.status: IKM supplier matchmaking, not verified supplier shipment or investment realization
industry.participants: Kemenperin; Polytron; SGMW Motor Indonesia; VKTR and IKM

policies.title: EV acceleration framework
policies.instrument: Presidential Regulation 55/2019 as amended by Presidential Regulation 79/2023
policies.note: Battery electric vehicles and investment/local-content implementation; implementation rules and dated exemptions vary.

policies.title: Domestic-content roadmap (TKDN)
policies.note: Minimum 40% for 2022–2026, 60% for 2027–2029, 80% from 2030; specific applicability and transitional incentives require review.

policies.title: 2025 VAT / luxury tax incentives for certain BEVs
policies.status: Enacted for FY2025 only; do not assume automatically renewed in 2026
policies.note: Qualifying models and legal period strictly defined; a separate valid 2026 instrument must be checked.

policies.title: 2026 electric motorcycle purchase-incentive proposal
policies.instrument: Ministerial fiscal regulation awaited as of 30 September 2026
policies.status: Proposal delayed / not verified as in force
policies.note: A prior announcement of possible Rp5m support is not a payable subsidy without an effective PMK.

assessment: Kemenperin's national battery-electric fleet population reached 541,678 as of Aug 2026, but the latest publicly cited by-type split is April 2026, not August; these observations must be shown with different reference dates.
Passenger BEV wholesales accelerated in 2026, but market shipments must not be confused with registered stock, true end-user retail deliveries or long-term operating fleet.

Electric motorcycle adoption is weaker: AISMOLI reported only 18,900 units through August 2026, while the incentive instrument remained uncertain. Compare like-method and like-period data before quantifying decline.

The 2030 targets concern registered electric cars and two-wheelers. April Kemenperin population figures (223,100 cars and 242,909 motorcycles) imply ~11.2% and ~1.9% against the respective targets if the source scopes match; clarify unusual monthly registry revisions.

Charging expansion reached 4,769 PLN/partner SPKLU units at 3,097 sites in March 2026 and the 5,000th machine milestone in May; uptime, location, connector availability and access for two-wheelers need separate measures.

EV manufacturing value-added depends on local supplier participation, batteries and technology transfer. Manufacturing announcements and investment commitments do not establish realized local content or commercial viability.

Net emissions and energy-security benefits depend on grid emissions, electricity reliability, vehicle usage, battery lifecycle and displacement of imported petroleum; do not claim zero lifecycle emissions.
methodology: Observations are dated; source methods differ. No unaudited real-time vehicle registrations or station uptime are inferred. News is source discovery, not independent event verification.

latest_national.attribution: Kemenperin data cited by ANTARA Foto, 12 Oct 2026
latest_national.classification: All battery electric road-vehicle categories; not BEV passenger-car sales
latest_national.note: Overall national stock does not identify the August car and motorcycle split.

april_by_type.attribution: Industry ministry figures delivered in official Sept 2026 factory-opening statement, as reported ANTARA
april_by_type.discrepancy_warning: Published April stock appears to have increased unusually sharply from March; confirm original Kemenperin registry/definitions before declaring precise month-on-month physical adoption.
